name: Attio
description: Attio is a modern, AI-native CRM platform that provides a flexible data model and robust developer tools for building custom integrations and automations.

evidence.claim: Attio supports both OAuth 2.0 and API keys for authentication.
Attio provides an official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for connecting AI agents.
Attio offers a REST API with full read and write access and webhook support.
Attio has a developer console for managing apps and integrations.

notes: Attio is highly developer-friendly with a dedicated developer console, official MCP support, and clear documentation for both OAuth 2.0 and API key authentication.
